title: Great for everyday use
text: Great for everyday use. These are nice!  I do wish the necks of the bottle were a little wider.  It's difficult to clean inside the neck of the bottles.  Other than that, I like them.

product_metadata.title: Bormioli Rocco Giara Swing Top Bottles 33 ¾ Ounce/1 Liter (6 Pack) ROUND Clear Glass Grolsch Flip Top Bottle With Stopper
